comment: Client-bundle budget for the production build, checked by scripts/perf-budget.mjs. Every prerendered page is measured: the first rule whose glob matches sets its caps, and a page matching none falls to `default` — so a new route is covered the day it lands. First-load JS counts every chunk the page's HTML references plus their transitive static imports. Thresholds sit ~15 KB gz above main — roughly one dependency — so silent regressions fail CI. Raise one only with a reviewed reason.
